title: OFSCP Discoverable Feed Verification Request (v0.1)
description: Hub → callback intent-verification request (§8.4), provider-signed (§8.1) by the hub. The subscriber confirms by responding 200 with { "challenge": "<echoed>" }. Only on a matching echo does the hub activate (subscribe) or remove (unsubscribe) the subscription.

challenge.description: Random hub-generated value the subscriber MUST echo to confirm intent.

leaseSeconds.description: The lease the hub will grant (for subscribe). 0 for unsubscribe.
